thread:
asha: Quick heads-up — NovaHealth renewal (annual, $120k) is queued for signature but procurement just surfaced an obligor mismatch: their finance team says invoices must go to NovaHealth EU (affiliate) not NovaHealth Inc. This would require a billing-entity change. We need a path before EOD to avoid slipping the renewal. @jess_legal @ben_ae
ben_ae: Ugh — we already quoted and routed docs to the original legal entity. Customer says partner procurement needs PO to the EU entity. Do we have legal OK to swap invoice entity post-sign?
jess_legal: We can do entity swap but need: (1) confirmation of affiliate relationship (email from customer's finance/legal), (2) a revised SOW or amendment referencing the EU entity, and (3) updated tax/PO details. Risk: swapping invoicing entity after signature without an amendment is messy.
asha: They can send a finance email now. Procurement says they can generate PO within 24h if we accept an interim sign path. Is it workable to sign with the current SOW and then amend? Customer wants to avoid another round trip of exec approval.
jess_legal: If customer signs original SOW we can accept a short-form amendment afterwards. Require explicit language: "This amendment moves billing obligations to <AffiliateName> effective mm/dd/yyyy" and signature from authorized signer. We can prepare a lightweight amendment template.
ryan_ops: Timeline note — if we go amendment route, billing system needs new vendor code & tax id; Ops lead time ~2 business days once we get PO + tax info. If they need seats active tomorrow we can provision against the existing contract as provisional credit, but finance needs written confirmation.
ben_ae: Customer asked for a faster option: can we accept a credit card for the first invoice and then switch to PO for remaining term? they'd like to close today. @jess_legal thoughts on CC-first? :thinking_face:
jess_legal: CC-first is acceptable as an expedient if Finance approves. We need: (A) explicit email from customer confirming CC payment is temporary, (B) a follow-up amendment within 7 days, and (C) updated billing entity added to systems. Legal ok with that if we add a 30-day amendment SLA.
asha: I'll ask them to confirm by email now. In parallel can someone draft the amendment template? Prefer super short.
ess: (message deleted)
docusign-bot: Envelope created by ben_ae — envelopeId: 0f4a2c97 — status: sent — recipients: 2 (signer: ceo@novahealth.com, cc: finance@novahealth-eu.com)
ben_ae: Sent envelope to CEO. I'll hold off on voiding until we get customer finance email about affiliate. If they confirm CC-first, we'll sign and then do amendment.
ryan_ops: Action items: (1) asha to get finance email from customer (2) jess_legal to draft 1-paragraph amendment + checkbox for tax id (3) ops to queue vendor code creation after PO arrives. I'll monitor provisioning for provisional credit if needed.
asha: Customer finance just replied: "We confirm NovaHealth EU (VAT: GB999) is the invoicing entity. PO will be in transit within 24h, but to avoid service disruption we'll approve payment by CC for the initial invoice." Copying their email into thread: 
"From: finance@novahealth-eu.com
To: asha@redwood.com
Subject: Billing entity confirmation
We confirm NovaHealth EU (VAT: GB99999999) is the legal invoicing entity. PO is being raised; expect within 24 hours. We approve initial payment by CC to expedite."
ben_ae: Perfect. Jess — can you push the amendment draft to me in the next hour so I can attach to the envelope post-sign?
jess_legal: On it — will post a one-paragraph amendment below and DM with the redline. Draft: 
"This Amendment, effective on the date signed, changes the invoicing and payment obligations under the Agreement to NovaHealth EU (VAT: GB99999999). All other terms remain unchanged. Customer will provide PO within 7 days and transfer will be reflected in billing systems upon receipt."
asha: Thanks all. Customer signed via envelope 0f4a2c97 just now :tada: — Ben please attach amendment and confirm when PO lands. Closing risk: low, follow-up for systems change.
ben_ae: Got the signature. I'll attach the amendment and set a 7-day checklist for finance/ops.
jess_legal: I'll file the amendment and note delegation for billing entity change. Marking legal: resolved pending PO.
ryan_ops: I'll create vendor code ticket and set provisional credit flag until PO processed. ETA 2 business days.
asha: Closing thread — renewal executed, deliverables: amendment signed, PO pending, ops vendor-code in queue. Thanks team :raised_hands:
